title: The Corner Kick — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The corner kick is hope compressed into an arc
Eleven men moving into the box
With entirely different ideas about where the ball is going to land

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
コーナーキックは希望だ [The corner kick is hope]
弧の中に圧縮された [Compressed into an arc]
十一人の男たちがボックスに動く [Eleven men moving into the box]
ボールがどこに落ちるかについて [With entirely different ideas]
まったく異なるアイデアを持って [About where the ball is going to land]

[Chorus — English]
The corner says — everyone into the box, near post flick-on
Somewhere between all those instructions the ball arrives
And two very large men jump at the same time

[Bridge — 中文]
短角球是完全不同的哲学 [The short corner is a different philosophy entirely]
短角球说 — 我们思考过这个问题 [The short corner says — we've thought about this]
短角球说 — 我们不想要混乱 [The short corner says — we don't want chaos]
我们想要一个角度 [We want an angle]
人群对短角球发出抱怨 [The crowd groans at the short corner]
因为他们是为了混乱而来的 [Because they came for the chaos]
而他们没有得到 [And they didn't get it]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas loved the corner — said it's the only moment where chaos is officially scheduled

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
The corner kick
コーナーキック [The corner kick]
角球 [The corner kick]
That's my boy
